text: The words. Set the heading level (H1, H2, H3) inside the text box. Some copies show a page field instead of typed words.
ts_page_title_fallback: When this text is empty on a page (for example a page field left blank), the page's title shows here as the main heading (H1).
max_width: Leave at **Normal**. Many Tangent styles set their own line length and ignore it.
type_preset: Keep **Default**. Ignored when a **Tangent style** is set.
ts_style: The look of the text: font, size, color and any marks. Each style is described above. Overrides **Preset**, **Font** and **Size**.
ts_hide_section_when_blank: Hides the whole section on the live site when this text is empty, for example a blank page field. The editor still shows it, so you can fill it in.
ts_field_wrapper: Turn on when you type words here instead of a page field (service and location pages), so paragraph spacing stays the same. Then edit them in the sidebar.
font: Ignored when a **Tangent style** is set.
font_size: Ignored when a **Tangent style** is set.
line_height: Ignored by almost every **Tangent style**, which sets its own.
letter_spacing: Ignored when a **Tangent style** is set.
case: Ignored when a **Tangent style** is set. Write in sentence case instead.
text_color: Leave empty. The blue headings (Display, Heading large and medium, Stat value, Statement title and Row heading) ignore it.
background: Leave off. Boxes behind text aren't part of the Tangent design.
